about: In-scope questions list a phrase that a correct retrieved passage must contain. Out-of-scope questions are not covered by the notes; the assistant should refuse them.

How do you delete a BST node that has two children?
How does an AVL tree stay balanced?
Why do databases use B-trees?
Where are the children of index i in an array heap?
How fast is building a heap from n elements?
When should I use an adjacency list instead of a matrix?
Which traversal finds shortest paths in an unweighted graph?
Why does Dijkstra fail with negative weights?
How does Kruskal's algorithm detect cycles?
What makes quicksort hit its worst case?
